name: Antler US
identity_check: Antler US: the United States arm of Antler (antler.co), with its own location page (antler.co/location/us, headed 'Go further, faster with Antler in the US'), offices in NYC, SF and Austin, and its own team led by Bob Rosin (Managing Partner, US). Team bios, the Embark page and Antler blog posts say 'Antler US'. Its funds file SEC Form D as Antler U.S. Fund I, LP (Brooklyn, NY) and Antler US Fund II LP (New York, NY). Only US funds, people, terms and deals are recorded; the global parent is the separate record 'antler' and the India arm is 'antler-india'. Not Antler Elevate (Antler's later-stage fund, which also invests in US companies, e.g. Agentio's Series B), not Antler Creek Capital Partners (an unrelated Austin fund on EDGAR) and not other unrelated 'Antler' entities.

open_items: US fund sizes not found. Antler U.S. Fund I, LP (Form D filed 2020-01-17, D/A 2021-08-03, Brooklyn) and Antler US Fund II LP (Form D 2023-12-18, D/A 2024-12-18, New York) appear in EDGAR full-text search, with parallel 'Fund I-A' and 'Fund II-A' vehicles; the Form D documents (offering amounts) returned SEC's 'undeclared automated tool' page for the 'CapitalAtlas research' User-Agent, so they were skipped. Fund II close_date is the 6 Jan 2026 announcement date.

The $160M figure (WSJ headline listed on Antler's newsroom, 5 Jan 2026; user lead) is probably the second US fund but is unconfirmed. DevX (Mar 2026, https://www.devx.com/?p=85584) says Antler 'more than doubled the size of its US fund' (Jeff Becker), with no figures. Fund I size unknown.

EDGAR also lists Antler Special Opportunities Fund I, II and III LP (New York, Form Ds Jun-Aug 2026) and iCapital-Antler Elevate Global Fund II; whether the Special Opportunities vehicles belong to Antler US is not stated. Triangle Health's round names an 'Antler Criticality Fund with the State of New Mexico'; its relation to the US funds is not stated (the Jan 2026 release names the New Mexico State Investment Council as an LP).

Instrument and equity not stated for the US residency: the US page gives $500K-$1M plus $650K partner credits; the Jun 2025 blog gives a target of 8-12% ownership through seed. No SAFE / priced-equity detail found. No fee to join the residency.

requires_us_entity left 'unknown': the US residency says no incorporated startup is needed on day one, but nothing says which jurisdiction is required. Embark (SF, for India-based AI founders without a US work visa) says its programme partners help with 'US Incorporation, Visa and Banking'.

Indian founders: the US residency requires at least one co-founder to already hold US work authorization ('independent, indefinite, and unrestricted'; citizens, permanent residents or similar) and 'Antler does not provide visa sponsorship', so founders relocating from India on a visa do not qualify for the US residency. The Embark page sends founders who already have a US work visa or live in the US to Antler US; India-based founders without a visa go to Embark ($450K cheque leading a $600K-$800K pre-seed; 4-6 weeks in SF; Embark 4 in Oct 2026; runs May and October). Which Antler vehicle writes the Embark cheque is not stated; Bob Rosin (Managing Partner, Antler US) is listed as an Embark speaker.

Antler entity per round: articles say 'Antler'. HIFI, Doorstep, Agentio, Sweatpals and Triangle Health are on the Jan 2026 release's 'Select U.S. Investments' list; HIFI's Series A release is tagged Global and quotes Chris Millisits, Principal, Antler, who is not on the US team page (Antler first backed HIFI in May 2023 at pre-seed). Biota (Colorado; Antler ran residencies in Boulder), Mentium and Loman AI (Austin), Harper and Rebolt (Antler founder stories tagged US) are inferred to be Antler US deals.

Not recorded: Agentio $40M Series B (Nov 2025, led by Forerunner) because the participant is Antler Elevate, not Antler US; Clouted $7M seed (TechCrunch does not name Antler); AminoChain seed (a16z crypto lead; search results say Antler Elevate). Tandem (AI copilot for hardware engineers, CAD; 'Closed a $4.7M Seed Round' per Antler's Spring 2026 US showcase) has no round article naming Antler; the 'antler' record holds a database-only $5.0M pre-seed for it. Worth a competitor check (design_intent layer).

Dodge AI (AI agents for SAP/ERP maintenance; founders from BITS Pilani; $2.65M led by Accel and Google's AI fund with Antler participating, The Next Web, 29 Sep 2026; VCBacked lists San Francisco) and IndustrialMind (Mountain View; $1.2M pre-seed Oct 2025) are Embark founder stories; not recorded here because the Antler entity is not stated (antler-india lists Dodge.ai in its portfolio).
US portfolio count not stated: the US page and Jan 2026 release give only global totals (1,600+ / over 1,800 companies). The Spring 2026 US showcase lists 31 companies.

Partner focus sectors not stated for US partners on the US page. Chris Walsh is called 'General Partner, San Francisco' in the Jan 2026 release but 'Partner, Antler Elevate' on the Embark page; not listed. Tyler Norwood (Venture Partner, U.S., Jun 2025 blog) is not on the current team page.

Rounds rest on one page each except Harper, Biota and Doorstep (plus database hints). Triangle Health date given to the month (Pulse 2.0 published 27 Mar 2026; other reports say 24 Mar); no lead named. Biota's HQ is Longmont per its release (VCBacked says Boulder). Websites for Doorstep, Mentium and Triangle Health not taken from a fetched page.
